   if(a==='settings'){open('auto-planning');return;}
   if(a==='work-post'){r15OpenWorkComposer();return;}
   if(a==='generate'){const form=$p('r15AutoForm');if(!form.reportValidity())return;const date=$p('r15PlanDate').value;b.disabled=true;b.textContent='מחשב תוכנית…';setTimeout(()=>{try{r15BuildPlan(date);render();document.querySelector('.r15-proposal')?.scrollIntoView({block:'start',behavior:'smooth'});}catch(err){toast(err.message);b.disabled=false;b.textContent='הפק הצעת תכנון';}},25);return;}
   if(a==='approve'){modal('אישור תוכנית שיבוץ',`<p>${r15Preview.jobsPlanned} עבודות ב־${r15Preview.slots.length} שיבוצים יתווספו ללוח. לא יוחלפו שיבוצים קיימים.</p><p>הצעת המשך/מונעת יכולה לכלול כמה מקטעים לאותה עבודה. אין בכך אישור לביצוע בשטח.</p><label class="p-check"><input type="checkbox" name="ack" required><span>בדקתי צוות, אומדני זמן ותכנון. לפני ביצוע ייבדקו כשירות, היתרים ובידודים לפי נהלי התחנה.</span></label>`,form=>{const result=r15ApplyPlan(new FormData(form).has('ack'));toast(result.count+' שיבוצים נשמרו בלוח');return result;},'אשר והוסף ללוח');return;}
  }catch(err){$p('pilotModal').open?showFormError(err):toast(err.message);}return;}
  const host=e.target.closest('.r15-feed-work');if(!host)return;
  const card=host.querySelector('.work-card'),tab=e.target.closest('[data-tab]'),op=e.target.closest('[data-op]'),notes=e.target.closest('[data-toggle-ops-notes]');
  if(tab){e.preventDefault();e.stopImmediatePropagation();r15SelectTab(card,tab.dataset.tab);return;}
  if(notes){e.preventDefault();e.stopImmediatePropagation();window.TOVATI_MOBILE.setNotesOpen(card,notes.getAttribute('aria-expanded')!=='true');return;}
  if(op){e.preventDefault();e.stopImmediatePropagation();try{applyWorkPriority(host.dataset.r15Work,op.dataset.op,true);r15RefreshFeedCards();}catch(err){toast(err.message);}return;}
 },true);
 document.addEventListener('change',e=>{if(e.target.closest('.r15-feed-work')&&e.target.matches('[data-manual]')){e.preventDefault();e.stopImmediatePropagation();try{saveFrom(e.target);}catch(err){toast(err.message);}}},true);
 document.addEventListener('focusout',e=>{if(e.target.closest('.r15-feed-work')&&e.target.matches('textarea[data-manual],input[data-manual]')){try{saveFrom(e.target);}catch(err){toast(err.message);}}},true);
 window.addEventListener('tovati:summary-rendered',r15RenderReportState);
 window.addEventListener('scroll',r15ReportScrollCheck,{passive:true});
 window.addEventListener('tovati:committed',()=>{r15CompletedSync();setTimeout(r15RefreshFeedCards,0);});
 window.TOVATI_AUTOPLAN={version:'1.16.0',open:()=>open('auto-planning'),config:r15Config,save:r15SaveConfig,generate:r15BuildPlan,apply:r15ApplyPlan,preview:()=>r15Preview?clone(r15Preview):null};
 window.TOVATI_WORK_CARDS={publish:r15PublishWork,refresh:r15RefreshFeedCards};
 r15AfterRender();
}


// R17: WhatsApp-like local chat workspace.
// Conversation data is stored in the local pilot state. This does not create cross-device delivery.
let r17ActiveChat='',r17ChatQuery='';
const r17Me=()=>currentTestUser()||{id:'local-admin',name:db.profile.name||'מנהל מקומי',role:'מנהל',branch:'operations',active:true};
const r17Time=at=>{try{return new Intl.DateTimeFormat('he-IL',{hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit'}).format(new Date(at));}catch{return'';}};
const r17Day=at=>{try{return new Intl.DateTimeFormat('he-IL',{day:'2-digit',month:'2-digit',year:'numeric'}).format(new Date(at));}catch{return'';}};
function r17ValidateChats(x,out){
 const rows=x.chatMessages||[];if(!Array.isArray(rows)||rows.length>MAXROWS)throw Error('רשימת הצ׳אטים אינה תקינה.');out.chatMessages=cleanObject(rows);const ids=new Set();
 for(const m of out.chatMessages){const hasAttachment=!!(m?.attachment&&typeof m.attachment==='object'&&['image','video','work'].includes(m.attachment.type));if(!m||typeof m.id!=='string'||ids.has(m.id)||typeof m.conversationId!=='string'||typeof m.senderId!=='string'||typeof m.senderName!=='string'||typeof m.text!=='string'||(!m.text.trim()&&!hasAttachment)||m.text.length>4000||typeof m.at!=='string')throw Error('הודעת צ׳אט אינה תקינה.');ids.add(m.id);}
 const reads=x.chatRead||{};if(!reads||typeof reads!=='object'||Array.isArray(reads)||Object.keys(reads).length>MAXROWS)throw Error('מצב קריאת הצ׳אטים אינו תקין.');out.chatRead=cleanObject(reads);
}
function r17DirectId(a,b){return 'dm:'+ [String(a),String(b)].sort().join(':');}
function r17GroupKey(value){return String(value||'').trim().replace(/[^\p{L}\p{N}_-]+/gu,'_').slice(0,100)||'none';}
function r17Groups(){
 const u=r17Me(),maintenance=u.branch==='maintenance',section=maintenance?(u.section||'ללא מדור'):(u.controlRoom||u.orgUnit||'תפעול'),dept=maintenance?(u.dept||'ללא מחלקה'):(u.orgUnit||'תפעול');
 const sectionSubtitle=maintenance?userGroupName('section',u.section,u.dept):(u.controlRoom||orgUnitName(u)||'תפעול');
 const deptSubtitle=maintenance?userDeptName(u.dept):(orgUnitName(u)||'תפעול');
 return [
  {id:`group:section:${r17GroupKey(u.branch)}:${r17GroupKey(dept)}:${r17GroupKey(section)}`,kind:'group',title:'המדור שלי',subtitle:sectionSubtitle||section,icon:'👥',accent:'section'},
  {id:`group:department:${r17GroupKey(u.branch)}:${r17GroupKey(dept)}`,kind:'group',title:'המחלקה שלי',subtitle:deptSubtitle||dept,icon:'🏭',accent:'department'},
  ...[1,2,3,4].map(n=>({id:`group:overhaul:${n}`,kind:'group',title:`שיפוץ יחידה ${n}`,subtitle:'קבוצה קבועה לכל המשתמשים',icon:'🛠️',accent:'overhaul'}))
 ];
}
function r17GroupMembers(conv){
 const users=db.workers.filter(w=>w.active),u=r17Me();
 if(conv.id.startsWith('group:overhaul:'))return users;
 if(conv.id.startsWith('group:section:')){
  if(u.branch==='maintenance')return users.filter(w=>w.branch==='maintenance'&&w.dept===u.dept&&(!u.section||sectionMatches(w.section,u.section)||sectionMatches(u.section,w.section)));
  return users.filter(w=>w.branch==='operations'&&((u.controlRoom&&w.controlRoom===u.controlRoom)||(u.orgUnit&&w.orgUnit===u.orgUnit)));
 }
 if(conv.id.startsWith('group:department:'))return u.branch==='maintenance'?users.filter(w=>w.branch==='maintenance'&&w.dept===u.dept):users.filter(w=>w.branch==='operations');
 return [];
}
function r17Messages(id){return (db.chatMessages||[]).filter(m=>m.conversationId===id).sort((a,b)=>String(a.at).localeCompare(String(b.at)));}
function r17OtherUser(id){const me=r17Me().id,parts=String(id).split(':').slice(1);const other=parts.find(x=>x!==me);return db.workers.find(w=>w.id===other)||null;}
function r17Conversation(id){const fixed=r17Groups().find(g=>g.id===id);if(fixed)return fixed;if(String(id).startsWith('dm:')){const u=r17OtherUser(id);return u?{id,kind:'direct',title:u.name,subtitle:[u.role,u.branch==='maintenance'?userDeptName(u.dept):orgUnitName(u)].filter(Boolean).join(' · '),user:u}:null;}return null;}
function r17AllConversations(){
 const me=r17Me().id,groups=r17Groups(),ids=new Set();for(const m of db.chatMessages||[]){if(m.conversationId.startsWith('dm:')&&m.conversationId.split(':').includes(me))ids.add(m.conversationId);}
 const direct=[...ids].map(r17Conversation).filter(Boolean);return [...groups,...direct];
}
function r17Last(conv){return r17Messages(conv.id).at(-1)||null;}
function r17Unread(conv){const me=r17Me().id,last=String(db.chatRead?.[me]?.[conv.id]||'');return r17Messages(conv.id).filter(m=>m.senderId!==me&&String(m.at)>last).length;}
function r17MarkRead(id){const me=r17Me().id,msg=r17Messages(id).at(-1);if(!msg||msg.senderId===me&&String(db.chatRead?.[me]?.[id]||'')>=msg.at)return;const d=clone(db);d.chatRead=d.chatRead||{};d.chatRead[me]=d.chatRead[me]||{};d.chatRead[me][id]=msg.at;d.revision++;d.updatedAt=now();try{persistDb(d);db=d;}catch{}}
function r17Avatar(conv,size=''){if(conv.kind==='direct'&&conv.user)return tfAvatar(conv.user,conv.user.name);return `<span class="r17-group-avatar ${size} ${conv.accent||''}">${conv.icon||'👥'}</span>`;}
function r18MessagePreview(m){if(!m)return'';const a=m.attachment;if(a?.type==='image')return'📷 תמונה'+(m.text?' · '+m.text:'');if(a?.type==='video')return'🎥 סרטון'+(m.text?' · '+m.text:'');if(a?.type==='work')return'📄 פקודת עבודה · '+(a.snapshot?.order||a.snapshot?.notification||'עבודה')+(m.text?' · '+m.text:'');return m.text||'';}
function r17ConversationRow(conv){const last=r17Last(conv),unread=r17Unread(conv),preview=last?(last.senderId===r17Me().id?'את/ה: ':'')+r18MessagePreview(last):(conv.kind==='group'?(conv.subtitle||'קבוצה קבועה'):'התחלת שיחה חדשה');return `<button type="button" class="r17-conversation" data-r17-action="open" data-id="${escape(conv.id)}">${r17Avatar(conv)}<span class="r17-conversation-copy"><strong>${escape(conv.title)}</strong><small>${escape(preview)}</small></span><span class="r17-conversation-meta">${last?`<time>${escape(r17Time(last.at))}</time>`:''}${unread?`<b>${unread>99?'99+':unread}</b>`:''}</span></button>`;}
function r17LegacyCount(){return db.posts.filter(p=>p.kind==='message').length;}
function renderR17Messages(){
 if(r17ActiveChat){const conv=r17Conversation(r17ActiveChat);if(!conv)r17ActiveChat='';else return r17ChatScreen(conv);}
 const q=r17ChatQuery.trim().toLocaleLowerCase('he'),all=r17AllConversations(),filtered=q?all.filter(c=>(c.title+' '+c.subtitle).toLocaleLowerCase('he').includes(q)):all;
 const groups=filtered.filter(c=>c.kind==='group'),direct=filtered.filter(c=>c.kind==='direct'),legacy=r17LegacyCount();
 return `<section class="r17-wa"><header class="r17-wa-header"><div><h2>הודעות</h2><small>צ׳אטים פרטיים וקבוצות צוות</small></div><button type="button" class="r17-round" data-r17-action="new" aria-label="שיחה פרטית חדשה">${ico('plus')}</button></header><label class="r17-search"><span class="r17-search-icon">⌕</span><input type="search" value="${escape(r17ChatQuery)}" data-r17-search placeholder="חיפוש שיחה או משתמש" autocomplete="off"></label><div class="r17-pinned-title">קבוצות קבועות</div><div class="r17-chat-list r17-groups">${groups.map(r17ConversationRow).join('')}</div><div class="r17-list-title"><span>שיחות פרטיות</span><button type="button" data-r17-action="new">שיחה חדשה</button></div><div class="r17-chat-list">${direct.length?direct.map(r17ConversationRow).join(''):`<div class="r17-empty"><b>אין עדיין שיחות פרטיות</b><span>לחץ על „שיחה חדשה” ובחר עובד.</span></div>`}</div>${legacy?`<details class="r17-legacy"><summary>הודעות מהגרסה הקודמת · ${legacy}</summary>${db.posts.filter(p=>p.kind==='message').slice(0,30).map(p=>`<article><b>${escape(p.author)}</b><small>${escape(stampLabel(p.at))}</small><p>${escape(p.text)}</p></article>`).join('')}</details>`:''}<div class="r17-local-warning">השיחות נשמרות במכשיר הזה. הן נראות כשמחליפים משתמש באותו מאגר מקומי; אין עדיין סנכרון בין טלפונים שונים.</div></section>`;
}
function r18WorkSnapshot(ref){const r=record(ref);if(!r)return null;return{ref:r.ref,notification:r.notification||notificationNo(r)||'',order:r.order||orderNo(r)||'',permit:r.permit||permitNo(r)||'',title:r.title||description(r)||'עבודה',dept:recordDept(r)||r.dept||'',section:recordSection(r)||r.section||'',priority:r.priority||priorityValue(r)||'',status:r13StateOf(r)?.label||''};}
function r18WorkAttachmentHTML(a){const x=a?.snapshot||{};return `<button type="button" class="r18-work-card" data-r18-action="open-work" data-ref="${escape(x.ref||'')}"><span class="r18-work-top"><b>פקודת עבודה</b>${x.priority?`<em>${escape(x.priority)}</em>`:''}</span><strong>${escape(x.title||'עבודה')}</strong><span>${x.notification?`הודעה ${escape(x.notification)} · `:''}${x.order?`הזמנה ${escape(x.order)}`:'ללא הזמנה'}${x.permit?` · היתר ${escape(x.permit)}`:''}</span><small>${escape([x.dept?userDeptName(x.dept):'',x.section,x.status].filter(Boolean).join(' · '))}</small></button>`;}
function r18ChatAttachment(m){const a=m.attachment;if(!a)return'';if(a.type==='work')return r18WorkAttachmentHTML(a);const media=a.media||{};const attrs=media.mediaId?`data-r18-media="${escape(media.mediaId)}"`:media.src?`src="${escape(window.TOVATI_MEDIA.safeURL(media.src))}"`:'';return a.type==='video'?`<video class="r18-chat-media" ${attrs} controls playsinline preload="metadata"></video>`:`<button type="button" class="r18-chat-image-btn" data-r18-action="view-media" data-id="${escape(m.id)}"><img class="r18-chat-media" ${attrs} alt="תמונה בצ׳אט" loading="lazy"></button>`;}
async function r18HydrateChatMedia(root=document){for(const el of root.querySelectorAll('[data-r18-media]')){if(el.src)return;const id=el.dataset.r18Media,m={mediaId:id,type:el.tagName==='VIDEO'?'video':'image'};try{const src=await window.TOVATI_MEDIA.source(m);if(src)el.src=src;else el.closest('.r17-bubble')?.classList.add('media-missing');}catch{}}}
function r17ChatScreen(conv){
 const me=r17Me(),messages=r17Messages(conv.id),members=conv.kind==='group'?r17GroupMembers(conv):[me,conv.user].filter(Boolean);r17MarkRead(conv.id);
 let prevDay='';const body=messages.map(m=>{const day=r17Day(m.at),sep=day!==prevDay?`<div class="r17-day">${escape(day)}</div>`:'';prevDay=day;const mine=m.senderId===me.id;return `${sep}<div class="r17-bubble-row ${mine?'mine':'theirs'}"><div class="r17-bubble">${conv.kind==='group'&&!mine?`<b class="r17-sender">${escape(m.senderName)}</b>`:''}${r18ChatAttachment(m)}${m.text?`<p>${escape(m.text)}</p>`:''}<span>${escape(r17Time(m.at))}${mine?' ✓✓':''}</span></div></div>`;}).join('');
 return `<section class="r17-wa r17-chat"><header class="r17-chat-header"><button type="button" class="r17-back" data-r17-action="back" aria-label="חזרה">‹</button>${r17Avatar(conv,'small')}<div><strong>${escape(conv.title)}</strong><small>${conv.kind==='group'?`${members.length} משתתפים · ${escape(conv.subtitle||'')}`:escape(conv.subtitle||'')}</small></div><button type="button" class="r17-round subtle" data-r17-action="info" data-id="${escape(conv.id)}" aria-label="פרטי שיחה">ⓘ</button></header><div class="r17-chat-wall">${body||`<div class="r17-first-message"><b>${escape(conv.title)}</b><span>אין הודעות עדיין. אפשר להתחיל את השיחה.</span></div>`}</div><div class="r19-attach-tray" data-r19-tray hidden><button type="button" data-r18-action="pick-image" data-id="${escape(conv.id)}"><span>📷</span><b>תמונה</b></button><button type="button" data-r18-action="pick-video" data-id="${escape(conv.id)}"><span>🎥</span><b>סרטון</b></button><button type="button" data-r18-action="pick-work" data-id="${escape(conv.id)}"><span>📄</span><b>פקודת עבודה</b></button></div><form class="r17-composer r18-composer" data-r17-chat-form data-id="${escape(conv.id)}"><button type="button" class="r18-attach-button" data-r18-action="attach-menu" data-id="${escape(conv.id)}" aria-label="צירוף" aria-expanded="false">＋</button><textarea name="text" rows="1" maxlength="4000" placeholder="הודעה"></textarea><button type="submit" aria-label="שליחה">➤</button></form><input type="file" data-r18-chat-file accept="image/jpeg,image/png,image/webp,image/gif,video/mp4,video/webm,video/quicktime" hidden></section>`;
}
function r17OpenNewChat(){const me=r17Me(),users=db.workers.filter(w=>w.active&&w.id!==me.id).sort(compareUsers);modal('שיחה פרטית חדשה',`<label class="r17-contact-search"><span>בחר עובד</span><select name="user" required>${option('','בחר עובד','')}${users.map(u=>option(u.id,u.name+' · '+u.role+' · '+(u.branch==='maintenance'?userDeptName(u.dept):orgUnitName(u)),'')).join('')}</select></label><p class="r17-modal-note">השיחה פרטית בין שני המשתמשים בתוך מאגר הפיילוט המקומי.</p>`,form=>{const id=values(form).user;if(!id)throw Error('בחר עובד.');r17ActiveChat=r17DirectId(me.id,id);return{id};},'פתח שיחה');}
function r18Send(id,text='',attachment=null){text=String(text||'').trim().slice(0,4000);if(!text&&!attachment)throw Error('יש לכתוב הודעה או לצרף קובץ.');const me=r17Me();if(!me.id)throw Error('יש לבחור משתמש.');const conv=r17Conversation(id);if(!conv)throw Error('השיחה אינה זמינה.');if(conv.kind==='direct'&&!conv.user?.active)throw Error('המשתמש אינו פעיל.');const msg={id:uid('chat'),conversationId:id,senderId:me.id,senderName:me.name||'משתמש',text,attachment:attachment||undefined,at:now()};commit('שליחת הודעת צ׳אט מקומית',id,d=>{d.chatMessages=d.chatMessages||[];d.chatMessages.push(msg);if(d.chatMessages.length>MAXROWS)d.chatMessages=d.chatMessages.slice(-MAXROWS);});return msg;}
function r17Send(id,text){return r18Send(id,text,null);}
let r18PendingConversation='';
function r18AttachmentMenu(id){r18PendingConversation=id;const tray=document.querySelector('[data-r19-tray]'),btn=document.querySelector('[data-r18-action="attach-menu"]');if(!tray){toast('אפשר לצרף תמונה, סרטון או פקודת עבודה.');return;}const open=tray.hidden;tray.hidden=!open;tray.classList.toggle('is-open',open);if(btn)btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded',String(open));if(open)tray.querySelector('button')?.focus({preventScroll:true});}
function r18FileInput(){return document.querySelector('[data-r18-chat-file]');}
function r18PickMedia(id,type){r18PendingConversation=id;closeModal(true);requestAnimationFrame(()=>{const input=r18FileInput();if(!input)return;input.accept=type==='image'?'image/jpeg,image/png,image/webp,image/gif':'video/mp4,video/webm,video/quicktime,video/ogg';input.dataset.r18Kind=type;input.click();});}
async function r18SendFile(file,type){if(!file||!r18PendingConversation)return;const mode=type==='video'?'video':'feed';window.TOVATI_MEDIA.validateSelection([file],mode);toast('מכין '+(type==='video'?'סרטון':'תמונה')+'…');const entry=await window.TOVATI_MEDIA.prepare(file,mode);await window.TOVATI_MEDIA.putMany([entry]);const media=window.TOVATI_MEDIA.metadata(entry);try{r18Send(r18PendingConversation,'',{type,media});}catch(e){await window.TOVATI_MEDIA.remove([entry.id]).catch(()=>{});throw e;}render();requestAnimationFrame(()=>{r18HydrateChatMedia();const wall=document.querySelector('.r17-chat-wall');if(wall)wall.scrollTop=wall.scrollHeight;});}
function r18WorkOptions(q=''){const term=String(q||'').trim().toLowerCase(),rows=records().filter(sessionAllows).filter(r=>!term||[r.title,r.order,r.notification,r.permit].join(' ').toLowerCase().includes(term));return rows.slice(0,150);}
function r18PickWork(id){r18PendingConversation=id;const rows=r18WorkOptions();modal('צירוף פקודת עבודה',`<label><span>בחר עבודה</span><select name="workRef" required>${option('','בחר עבודה','')}${rows.map(r=>option(r.ref,(r.order||r.notification||'ללא מספר')+' · '+String(r.title||'').slice(0,70),'')).join('')}</select></label><p class="r17-modal-note">העבודה תישלח ככרטיס עם מספרים, תיאור, שיוך וסטטוס.</p>`,form=>{const ref=values(form).workRef,a=r18WorkSnapshot(ref);if(!a)throw Error('העבודה אינה זמינה.');r18Send(id,'',{type:'work',snapshot:a});r17ActiveChat=id;requestAnimationFrame(()=>{render();});return{ref};},'שליחת העבודה');}
function r18ShareWork(ref){const snap=r18WorkSnapshot(ref);if(!snap)throw Error('העבודה אינה זמינה.');const me=r17Me(),groups=r17Groups(),users=db.workers.filter(w=>w.active&&w.id!==me.id).sort(compareUsers);modal('שתף עבודה בצ׳אט',`<label><span>יעד</span><select name="target" required>${option('','בחר שיחה','')}${groups.map(g=>option(g.id,'קבוצה · '+g.title,'')).join('')}${users.map(u=>option('user:'+u.id,'פרטי · '+u.name+' · '+u.role,'')).join('')}</select></label><div class="r18-share-preview">${r18WorkAttachmentHTML({snapshot:snap})}</div>`,form=>{let target=values(form).target;if(target.startsWith('user:'))target=r17DirectId(me.id,target.slice(5));r18Send(target,'',{type:'work',snapshot:snap});r17ActiveChat=target;open('messages');return{target};},'שיתוף בצ׳אט');}
function r18ChatMessageById(id){return (db.chatMessages||[]).find(m=>m.id===id);}
async function r18ViewMedia(id){const m=r18ChatMessageById(id),media=m?.attachment?.media;if(!media)return;const src=await window.TOVATI_MEDIA.source(media);if(!src)throw Error('הקובץ אינו נמצא במכשיר.');modal('תמונה',`<img class="r18-modal-image" src="${escape(src)}" alt="תמונה מהצ׳אט">`);}
function r17Info(conv){const members=conv.kind==='group'?r17GroupMembers(conv):[r17Me(),conv.user].filter(Boolean);modal('פרטי שיחה',`<div class="r17-info"><header>${r17Avatar(conv,'small')}<div><h3>${escape(conv.title)}</h3><p>${escape(conv.subtitle||'')}</p></div></header><strong>${members.length} משתתפים</strong><div class="r17-member-list">${members.slice(0,80).map(u=>`<div>${tfAvatar(u,u.name)}<span><b>${escape(u.name)}</b><small>${escape(u.role||'')}</small></span></div>`).join('')}</div></div>`);}
function r17Install(){
 document.addEventListener('input',e=>{if(!e.target.matches('[data-r17-search]'))return;r17ChatQuery=e.target.value;clearTimeout(e.target._r17t);e.target._r17t=setTimeout(()=>{if(page==='messages')render();},120);});
 document.addEventListener('click',e=>{const b=e.target.closest('[data-r17-action]');if(!b)return;e.preventDefault();e.stopImmediatePropagation();try{const a=b.dataset.r17Action,id=b.dataset.id;if(a==='open'){r17ActiveChat=id;r17MarkRead(id);render();requestAnimationFrame(()=>{r18HydrateChatMedia();const wall=document.querySelector('.r17-chat-wall');if(wall)wall.scrollTop=wall.scrollHeight;});return;}if(a==='back'){r17ActiveChat='';render();return;}if(a==='new'){r17OpenNewChat();return;}if(a==='info'){const c=r17Conversation(id);if(c)r17Info(c);return;}}catch(err){toast(err.message);}},true);
 document.addEventListener('submit',e=>{if(!e.target.matches('[data-r17-chat-form]'))return;e.preventDefault();e.stopImmediatePropagation();try{const form=e.target,id=form.dataset.id,text=form.elements.namedItem('text').value;r18Send(id,text,null);form.reset();render();requestAnimationFrame(()=>{r18HydrateChatMedia();const wall=document.querySelector('.r17-chat-wall');if(wall)wall.scrollTop=wall.scrollHeight;document.querySelector('.r17-composer textarea')?.focus({preventScroll:true});});}catch(err){toast(err.message);}},true);
 document.addEventListener('click',async e=>{const b=e.target.closest('[data-r18-action]');if(!b)return;e.preventDefault();e.stopImmediatePropagation();try{const a=b.dataset.r18Action,id=b.dataset.id;if(a==='attach-menu')return r18AttachmentMenu(id);if(a==='pick-image'){document.querySelector('[data-r19-tray]')?.setAttribute('hidden','');return r18PickMedia(id,'image');}if(a==='pick-video'){document.querySelector('[data-r19-tray]')?.setAttribute('hidden','');return r18PickMedia(id,'video');}if(a==='pick-work'){document.querySelector('[data-r19-tray]')?.setAttribute('hidden','');return r18PickWork(id);}if(a==='open-work')return openRecord(b.dataset.ref);if(a==='view-media')return await r18ViewMedia(id);if(a==='share-work')return r18ShareWork(b.dataset.ref);}catch(err){toast(err.message);}},true);
document.addEventListener('change',async e=>{const input=e.target.closest?.('[data-r18-chat-file]');if(!input||!input.files?.[0])return;const file=input.files[0],kind=input.dataset.r18Kind||window.TOVATI_MEDIA.kind(file);input.value='';try{await r18SendFile(file,kind);}catch(err){toast(err.message);}},true);
const oldOpen=open;open=function(name,...args){if(name!=='messages')r17ActiveChat='';return oldOpen(name,...args);};
 window.TOVATI_CHAT={version:'1.19.0',open:()=>open('messages'),groups:r17Groups,conversations:()=>clone(r17AllConversations()),messages:id=>clone(r17Messages(id)),send:r17Send,sendAttachment:r18Send,shareWork:r18ShareWork};
}

install();
installTestUsersLogin();
installAutomation();
installSwipeNavigation();
tfInstall();
installTrafficClock();
r10Install();
r11Install();
r12Install();
r13Install();
r14Install();
r15Install();
r17Install();
})();


</script>

<script>
try{
 window.TOVATI_BOOT.status='ready';
 window.TOVATI_BOOT.counts={notifications:JSON.parse(document.getElementById('notificationsData').textContent).length,orders:JSON.parse(document.getElementById('ordersData').textContent).length,permits:JSON.parse(document.getElementById('permitsData').textContent).length,cards:JSON.parse(document.getElementById('sapData').textContent).length,pm:JSON.parse(document.getElementById('tovati-embedded-state').textContent).state.pmOrders.length,workers:JSON.parse(document.getElementById('tovati-embedded-state').textContent).state.workers.length};
 document.body.classList.remove('tovati-booting');
 document.getElementById('tovatiModularBoot')?.remove();
 window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('tovati:ready',{detail:window.TOVATI_BOOT}));
}catch(e){console.error(e);}
</script>
<script id="tovati-r23-runtime-fixes">
(()=>{
  const clean=()=>{
    document.querySelectorAll('#pilotShell>.p-local-bar,#pilotStorageWarning,[data-r18-action="share-work"],.r18-share-work').forEach(el=>el.remove());
    document.body.classList.remove('pilot-volatile');
  };
  clean();
  const mo=new MutationObserver(clean);
  mo.observe(document.documentElement,{subtree:true,childList:true});
})();
</script>
<script id="tovati-r24-runtime-fixes">
(()=>{
  const clean=()=>{
    document.querySelectorAll('#pilotShell>.p-local-bar,#pilotStorageWarning,[data-r18-action="share-work"],.r18-share-work').forEach(el=>el.remove());
    document.body.classList.remove('pilot-volatile');
  };
  const ensurePM=()=>{
    try{
      if(typeof db!=='undefined'&&typeof PM_EMBEDDED_SEED!=='undefined'&&PM_EMBEDDED_SEED.length&&(!db.pmOrders||!db.pmOrders.length)){
        db.pmOrders=clone(PM_EMBEDDED_SEED);
      }
    }catch(_e){}
  };
  clean();ensurePM();
  new MutationObserver(()=>{clean();ensurePM();}).observe(document.documentElement,{subtree:true,childList:true});
})();
</script>
